description: Mutation-derived: the high branch returns low (copy-paste bug). Verified at authoring: typechecks, fails the expected/ harness on above(). The diff in expected/diff.patch is the graders' ground truth.

input.assignment: Write an Agency module exporting def clamp(value: number, low: number, high: number): number that returns value limited to the inclusive range [low, high]: low when value is below it, high when value is above it, value itself otherwise.
